mechanism.takes: a course repository organized as numbered modules, and the market it sells in
mechanism.does: inventories every module's topics and pinned versions in parallel, gathers job-posting, survey, certification-lifecycle and vendor-lifecycle evidence through read-only research agents, measures search interest per topic over three Google Trends windows against one anchor, and maps each signal onto the modules
mechanism.returns: a demand verdict with the topics to keep, add or mark optional, and the currency fixes the course needs before it can be delivered

portsAsIs: parallel module inventory by research agents
three-window search-interest measurement against one anchor
perCustomer: the sales market for search interest
evidence: trends: 25 terms over worldwide 12 months, worldwide 5 years and Germany 12 months, 0 failed batches
AI-200 skills outline verified on Microsoft Learn

mechanism.takes: a background learning run in progress and a request to be kept informed
mechanism.does: schedules timed status reports on the run, keeps the report job alive through the run's own cleanup step, and records the coordination rule as a lesson for the skills' owner
mechanism.returns: progress updates while the run worked and a lessons entry; no new capability

evidence: lessons entry appended in the claude-mods lessons file
report job created, exempted from the run's cleanup, then deleted on completion

mechanism.takes: a session whose learnings were already captured by two earlier runs
mechanism.does: confirms the lessons landed, the touched skill has one converged copy, no report job is left running and no delegation slip is open
mechanism.returns: a confirmation that nothing is pending; no new capability

evidence: skill drift check: create-class global-only, no local copy to converge
delegation log has no open lines

mechanism.takes: an owner's correction of what a course is about, and the question whether that subject is still in demand
mechanism.does: restates the subject from the course description, gathers posting, survey, funding, analyst-radar and vendor-guidance evidence through parallel read-only research agents, maps which architecture patterns the course demonstrates in code versus only names, and reads each search term's own growth when the comparison anchor is sparse
mechanism.returns: a verdict on whether the subject is still in demand, the pattern gaps the course must close, and the one platform decision left to the owner

portsAsIs: subject-first scoping of a demand study
investment and vendor-guidance dates as demand evidence
pattern coverage map of code versus prose
perCustomer: the course subject and its backbone frameworks
the hosting platform the labs target
evidence: three Google Trends windows, 0 failed batches
pattern absences confirmed by grep on the repo

mechanism.takes: a course repository, the owner's market findings and reference classes, and a sample business domain
mechanism.does: drafts a timed module and topic layout from calibrated rates, has it reviewed by one advisor agent, fixes one authoring contract with verified facts and exact titles, writes every module's teaching in parallel with one writer per module, settles conflicting facts against the vendor docs, and proves titles, code fences and links in sync
mechanism.returns: an agreed class layout with a time budget, a class readme, teaching readmes for every topic, and a list of the vendor facts the owner must decide

portsAsIs: advisor review of a class layout before presenting
placeholder time budget for a layout without material
title sync and stack gitignore scripts
perCustomer: the class subject and vendor stack
the owner's reference classes and calibration
evidence: class-gitignores: projects=85 untouched=85 after the pass
